_comment: Pinned program for the PRESENCE query 'Are there any players visible?' on bernabeu-counter. Hits the existence op-path detect -> answer (from a `detections` binding), the shape SYSTEM_PROMPT lists for 'is there a ...?'. Authored for the eval harness's presence cell (D1 presence caveat): the cell had no pinned anchor, so this program is the derivation source for its ground truth + anchor-question text. The window 10000-10001ms @ fps1 samples the single legible frame (10000), whose cache carries 5 person detections; detect.on_pitch:true drops the off-pitch box (p4, bottom .25), leaving 4 on-pitch — still nonzero, so the existence answer still grounds to 'Yes'. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json. end_ms 10001 <= clip duration_ms 30086.
